mission.text: Implement P44.6 as the verified mode-routing and mutation-safety bridge that converts Write, Edit, Smart Write, and Smart Edit into explicit JSON contracts, runtime gates, route signals, evidence ledger entries, and P49.5-ready artifacts.

hardRequirements.text: EngineMode must be explicit and may not be inferred from data_source, report type, filename, markdown heading, or natural-language phrasing.
Write and edit operations must pass mode-aware WriteGate, EditScopeGuard, or SmartMutationEngine before repository mutation.
Smart Write must compile schema and route signal before artifact generation.
Smart Edit must audit first, emit findings, compile patch scope, and bind patch evidence before claiming resolution.
Final validation must use exact allowed commands and must reject no-tests-found, watch-mode output, command-not-found, timeout, silent pass patterns, and stale evidence.
P44.6 may export P49.5/P45 bridge artifacts but must not implement P45 runtime paths.

antiPatterns.text: Do not create a module and leave it unwired.
Do not hide machine-critical behavior in prose.
Do not parse generated Markdown preview for execution.
Do not use data_source as a mode switch.
Do not let ACCP reports authorize execution; reports are evidence only.
Do not mark Smart Edit complete without a finding-to-patch-to-evidence chain.

operatorNotes.text: Human preview is generated from JSON and non-authoritative.
Spec changes after locking require new lock or approved amendment.
P44.6 sits after P44 and before P49.5/P45 readiness. It is not the full P45 runtime implementation.
The intended phase order is P44/P44.6, then P49.5 bridge readiness, then P45 implementation.
